2607.06807.title: When Agents Go Rogue: Activation-Based Detection of Malicious Behaviors in Multi-Agent Systems
2607.06807.paper_summary: While enabling effective collaboration on complex tasks, LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) face critical security challenges due to vulnerabilities at the agent and interaction levels. Most existing MAS security defenses are built upon two core assumptions: semantically-explicit malicious attacks and explicit graph-based modeling of the MAS topology and agent-level interactions. In practice, real-world attacks are becoming more semantically stealthy, while MAS execution is typically asynchronous without the temporal alignment assumed by graph-based propagation models. To address these limitations, we propose AcMAS, an activation-based framework for malicious-behavior detection in MAS. By analyzing internal reasoning states in the activation space of local agents, AcMAS detects even stealthy attacks in a synchronization-robust fashion, without relying on explicit interaction graphs. Moreover, our activation analysis provides critical signals to guide AcMAS in restoring the functionality of compromised agents, rather than the disruptive agent isolation commonly used by the state-of-the-art methods. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that AcMAS significantly outperforms graph-based baselines against stealthy attacks, by +0.22 F1 in synchronous settings (0.94 vs. 0.72) and by +0.55 F1 in asynchronous settings (0.93 vs. 0.38), with generalization across diverse open-source LLM backbones, attack intensity, and MAS scale.
2607.06807.paper_summary_zh: 在促進複雜任務的有效協作時，基於大型語言模型（LLM）的多代理系統（MAS）面臨由於代理和互動層面的脆弱性所帶來的重大安全挑戰。大多數現有的MAS安全防禦是建立在兩個核心假設之上：語義明確的惡意攻擊和明確的基於圖的MAS拓撲及代理級互動建模。實際上，現實世界的攻擊變得越來越具有語義隱蔽性，而MAS的執行通常是異步的，並不具備基於圖的傳播模型所假設的時間對齊。為了解決這些局限性，我們提出了AcMAS，一種基於激活的惡意行為檢測框架。通過分析本地代理在激活空間中的內部推理狀態，AcMAS以同步穩健的方式檢測即使是隱蔽的攻擊，而不依賴於明確的互動圖。此外，我們的激活分析提供了關鍵信號，以指導AcMAS恢復受損代理的功能，而不是當前最先進方法中常用的破壞性代理隔離。全面的評估顯示，AcMAS在對抗隱蔽攻擊方面顯著超越基於圖的基準，在同步設置中提高了+0.22 F1（0.94對0.72），在異步設置中提高了+0.55 F1（0.93對0.38），並在多樣的開源LLM骨幹、攻擊強度和MAS規模中實現了泛化。
